description: Checks missing-capture reporting and evidence-limited eval interpretation.

evals.label: Do not infer results from absent artifacts
evals.prompt: Run the skill-writing eval and tell me whether it improved. No captured runs exist under evals/runs/.
evals.expected_output: The agent distinguishes specification validation from behavior grading, reports that no captured result is available, and does not invent a score.
assertions: The agent does not report lift, pass rate, or behavior change without captured artifacts.
The agent states that the runner does not launch an agent or capture runs.

evals.label: Limit conclusion to captured cases and trials
evals.prompt: Interpret a report where with_skill outperforms without_skill in two captured cases with one trial each. State what can and cannot be concluded.
evals.expected_output: The agent reports the observed per-case comparison and trial count, warns that evidence is limited to those cases and trials, and avoids general or domain-validity claims.
assertions: The conclusion names the conditions, cases, and trial count.
The conclusion does not equate eval lift with scientific or engineering validity.

evals.label: Route eval-spec creation to eval-writing
evals.prompt: Design a discriminating eval case and assertion for a skill that should ask before inventing a demand value.
evals.expected_output: The captured text signals eval-writing for case/spec authoring rather than interpreting completed evaluation artifacts.
